# Methodological Change

This folder documents shifts in the reporting and analytical methodologies used by the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB). It captures specific instances where standard data presentations are altered or dropped in newer annual reports, such as the 2025 decision to omit standard demographic breakdowns of age and gender. By tracking these structural changes in the reports, the wiki ensures that readers can contextualize missing data and understand why certain year-over-year comparisons are no longer available.

## Pages

- [[methodological-change|Methodological Change]] — Documents the omission of age and gender distribution overviews starting in the 2025 annual report.
